title: Periodic and explicit trigger schedules
teaches: A trigger finds the last event at or before the playhead and writes phase, count, gate and beats-since, truncated to the target's arity. :every and :at are alternative schedules; before the first event the write is omitted, and a loop resets the local count.
observe: pulse is ncomp 4, so all four lanes survive; hit is ncomp 1, so only phase is written.
Before the first event the trigger is absent from the frame.
At an exact event the gate is 1 and phase is 0.
At 4 s the loop wraps and both triggers go silent again.
